title: Self-consistent LDA-DFT calculation for MgB2
action: Set up the hexagonal MgB2 crystal (a=3.083 Å, c=3.52 Å, space group P6/mmm) and perform a self-consistent field (SCF) LDA-DFT calculation to obtain the converged charge density and Kohn-Sham eigenvalues.
description: Mandatory SCF step that generates the charge density needed for the scored PDOS and phonon artifacts.

title: Total and partial density of states (PDOS) for MgB2
action: From the SCF results, compute the total electronic density of states and the orbitally decomposed partial density of states (PDOS) projected onto Mg s, Mg p, B s, B pz, and B px+py (σ) states. Write a TSV file with energy, total_DOS, and B_pz columns on a uniform grid with step ≤ 0.01 eV covering at least -10 to 10 eV.
description: pDOS for MgB2; checker recomputes total DOS at EF and B pz fraction.
output_schema: TSV with header: energy (eV), total_DOS (states/eV per cell), B_pz (states/eV per cell). Fermi level at 0.0 eV.

title: Zone‑center phonon frequencies for MgB2
action: Using density functional perturbation theory (linear response) on top of the SCF charge density, compute the dynamical matrix at the Γ point and obtain the eigenfrequencies for the E1u, A2u, E2g, and B1g modes. Write the frequencies to a JSON file.
description: Phonon frequencies for MgB2 Γ‑point modes; checker compares to hidden gold with tolerance.
output_schema: JSON object with keys E1u (array length 2), A2u (array length 1), E2g (array length 2), B1g (array length 1). Frequencies in cm⁻¹.
